code.description: Present for minutes_required and minutes_pending billing errors.

detail.description: Service message or FastAPI validation errors.

message.description: API Gateway authorization errors use message instead of detail.
message.title: Message

requirements.description: Resolved test-wide requirements, each with kind, requested and resolved settings.
requirements.title: Requirements

evidence.description: Readback evidence for this condition; network readback is configuration, not measured throughput.
evidence.title: Evidence

availability.description: Snapshot availability or ON_DEMAND; not a reservation or live capacity guarantee.
availability.title: Availability

os.description: Windows for desktop; the catalog OS version for a mobile configuration.
os.title: Os

platform.description: Operating-system family, such as WINDOWS, IOS or ANDROID.
platform.title: Platform

id.description: Device test ID; pass this as test_id when filtering logs.
id.title: Id

noul.description: Agent assessment score; use status and checks for the test verdict.
noul.title: Noul

session_url.description: Dashboard evidence URL; requires sign-in to the owning account.
session_url.title: Session Url

cursor.description: Watermark for polling future events, even when next_cursor is null.
cursor.title: Cursor

next_cursor.description: Pass unchanged to fetch another existing page; null when caught up.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

completed.description: Number of device tests in a terminal state, including failures and cancellations.
completed.title: Completed

files.description: Original source URLs, when supplied. Visible only to an authorized caller.
files.title: Files

devices.description: Exact enabled catalog IDs, or all for the account’s enabled devices. At most eight unique targets; currently only desktop-chrome is unlocked.
devices.title: Devices

items.description: Public HTTPS URL, validated again before each download connection.

files.description: Public HTTPS upload source URLs selected by the agent from the natural instructions. No admission-time download.
files.title: Files

instructions.description: What to do and verify, in ordinary language. May include supported network, locale and timezone conditions. Whitespace is trimmed when stored.
instructions.title: Instructions

start_url.description: Public HTTPS starting URL without credentials or a private address.
start_url.title: Start Url

complete.description: Whether all provider counters are confirmed. Independent of execution status.
complete.title: Complete

BearerAuth.description: Project API key from the dashboard. Cookies do not authenticate /v1 requests.

info.description: Public project-scoped browser-test API. Generated from the backend runtime contract.
info.title: BrowserBunny API

get.description: Read the catalog snapshot and account-enabled targets. Only Windows Chrome is currently unlocked. Inspect capabilities.conditions for deployment support.

403.description: Gateway authorization or cross-origin request rejected.

post.description: Submit instructions for asynchronous execution. A new request returns 202; an identical idempotent replay returns the current run with 200. Conditions are compiled in the worker before browser allocation; acceptance is not verification. The API key selects the project. Up to eight enabled targets; one active run service-wide; ten new submission attempts per account per UTC minute.

parameters.description: Retain this key and the exact request when retrying an uncertain submission.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Existing run returned for an identical idempotent replay.

402.description: Account minutes or billing readiness required, or selected environment is locked.

403.description: Selected device is disabled for your account, or the gateway rejected authorization or origin.

409.description: Idempotency key reused with different inputs, or minutes reserved by a previous run.

429.description: Submission rate limit or an active browser run prevents admission.
